intent.subtype: clock multiplexer driven by an input select
intent.rationale: Whether clk_sel is a static strap or changes at run time (glitching clock) cannot be decided from the file.

labels.note: core_clk is produced by a combinational mux steered by the data signal clk_sel and used as a flop clock.
Clock is muxed by data input clk_sel through ordinary logic (glitchy data-driven clock).

settlement.note: core_clk is produced by a mux on the data input clk_sel and clocks a flop; a logic-driven clock is structural and bad regardless of how clk_sel behaves.
